discount.calculation_note: If all three percentages were sequential, the effective reduction would be 1 - (0.65 × 0.90 × 0.95) = 44.425%, not 50%. The source described it as up to 50%.

notes: Historical observation retained to document a stale indexed result and arithmetic ambiguity.

sources.evidence: Search-indexed snapshot: Peptira takes 35% off the entire catalog automatically, PEPTIDESAVE10 adds another 10% at checkout, and ACH payment adds 5% more. Ends Monday, September 7 at midnight MST.
